name: IVR
tagline: International Association for Inland Waterway Transport Representing European Shipping, Insurance and Survey Industries
hero_kpi_rationale: Indicateur clé reflétant l'engagement et la portée internationale de l'association dans le secteur du transport fluvial européen. Le congrès annuel rassemble les principales parties prenantes et démontre l'influence de l'IVR.

kpis.explanation: Total number of participants at the IVR annual congress from multiple European countries.
kpis.signal: Strong international participation demonstrating sector leadership and influence.
kpis.description: The 2024 IVR Congress in Frankfurt attracted 225 participants from 11 different countries, reflecting the association's role as a key platform for inland waterway stakeholders.

kpis.explanation: Number of staff working in the IVR Secretariat.
kpis.signal: Lean operational structure typical of an international non-profit association.
kpis.description: The IVR Secretariat operates with a small focused team of approximately 15 employees, reflecting its coordination and advocacy role rather than operational shipping activities.

kpis.name_fr: Participation au colloque de prévention des sinistres
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural IVR Loss Prevention Colloquium.
kpis.signal: Successful launch of new flagship event focused on loss prevention and risk management in inland navigation.
kpis.description: The first Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp on November 4, 2024 attracted approximately 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands and Germany, demonstrating market demand for specialized technical and financial loss prevention content.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies found in the annual report. The association focuses on regulatory collaboration, technical standards, loss prevention, and maritime safety.
evidence: No references to AI, machine learning, or algorithmic systems
No mention of automation initiatives or predictive analytics
Focus on human collaboration, standardization committees (CESNI), and technical guidelines
Emphasis on navigational safety, decarbonization, and regulatory compliance
